tip: For unreal ifs, se takes the imperfect subjunctive (avessi) and the result clause uses the conditional (viaggerei), not the future.
andare plus a past participle, va presa, makes a passive of obligation: va presa means must be taken, not just is taken.
come se, meaning as if, needs the subjunctive: come se avesse (imperfect), never the indicative come se ha.
